excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin. Wears signature thin-rimmed BLACK RECTANGULAR lens glasses, a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jean slacks and black dress shoes.
excavation_context.stage: Pneumatic Scribing Consolidated Sandstone from a Sauropod Vertebra

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1, wearing his black rectangular lens glasses, sits at his indoor museum laboratory workbench guiding a vibrating pneumatic air-scribe across a block of hard tan sandstone matrix under bright task lighting. His precise work isolates a giant, deeply excavated cervical vertebra of an Apatosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
